title: "Reproduce"

toc-depth: 2
---

```{python}
import json
from datetime import datetime
import _lib as L
meta = L.run_meta()
ver = meta.get("wersje", {})
gh = lambda f: f"[`{f}`]({L.REPO}/blob/main/{f})"
```

## Run

```bash
python3.12 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m jutro run  --config config/biologia_sp.yaml --probka 50   # sample: 50 biology + 300 contrast materials
python -m jutro run  --config config/biologia_sp.yaml               # full corpus
python -m jutro site --config config/biologia_sp.yaml --probka 50   # only rebuild this site from wyniki/
```

Finished steps are skipped on the next run (`--od-nowa` repeats them); `--kroki` runs chosen steps; `--bez-llm`
makes no API call. For another subject, copy the configuration file and change its `cel` section.

## What you need

```{python}
L.table([
    ("Python", ver.get("python", "3.12"), "everything", "yes"),
    ("Python packages", gh("requirements.txt"), "everything", "yes"),
    ("ZPE dump", "local copy, not distributed", "the corpus (step 1)", "yes"),
    ("Claude API key", "`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in a `.env` file", "steps 2, 5, 7", "yes, unless `--bez-llm`"),
    ("KWJP100, NKJP, SUBTLEX-PL lists", "download into `resources/freq/`", "frequencies (step 3)", "yes"),
    ("Java 11 + TermoPL 8.1.1", "download into `resources/tools/`", "C-value (step 4)", "no"),
    ("Stanza Polish models", "download into `resources/tools/`", "comparison tagger, TermoPL input", "no"),
    ("Wuggy Polish plugin, UniPseudo, WorldLex, Imbir list", "download into `resources/pseudo/`", "pseudoword generators (step 7)", "no"),
    ("Quarto", "1.9.36", "this site (step 8)", "no"),
], ["What", "Version or source", "Needed for", "Required"], "llll")
```

A step that lacks an optional resource logs it and continues without that method. The site alone can be rebuilt
from the committed `wyniki/` with only Python and Quarto.

```

```

## Not exactly repeatable

- Language-model answers are not deterministic; a fresh run can give different labels and pseudowords.
- Wuggy searches for a fixed time per template, so a slower machine can get fewer candidates.
- Sampling is seeded (`{python} meta.get("ziarno")`), so the same materials, benchmark forms and templates are drawn.

## Record of this run

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Versions

```{python}
L.table(ver.items(), ["Component", "Version"], "ll")
```

#### Steps

```{python}
rows = []
for name, t in meta.get("kroki", {}).items():
    a, b = datetime.fromisoformat(t["start"]), datetime.fromisoformat(t["koniec"])
    rows.append((name, a.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), b.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), f"{(b - a).total_seconds():.0f} s"))
L.table(rows, ["Step (last execution)", "Start", "End", "Duration"], "lllr")
```

:::

## Raw metrics files {#raw-metrics-files}

Every number on the [Results](results.qmd) page comes from one of these files.

```{python}
for p in sorted((L.OUT / "metryki").glob("*.json")):
    d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    body = json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    L.md(f"::: {{.callout-note collapse=\"true\" title=\"{p.name} · saved {d.get('_zapisano', '')}\"}}\n"
         f"[view on GitHub]({L.REPO}/blob/main/{L.rel(p)})\n\n````json\n{body}\n````\n:::")
```
